statements.checking: Finitely generated discrete Gsur, actual projection b0 in Cr*(Gsur), irrational canonical trace, class outside integral coefficient-free proper-action reduced assembly. No torsion-free assumption.
Image of tau_* composed with degree-zero assembly is rational for every countable discrete group; checked against Lück Theorem 0.3 and domain in Sections 4–5.
Projection in ordinary reduced group C*-algebra, all evaluation representations, kernel on valid copies and diagonal 1/ni.
Trace sum p^(-ki), exact ni copies at identity, mutually exclusive events, irrationality and rationalized non-surjectivity.

proofPassages.passage: Lemmas 2.2–2.4: compressed diagrams, avoidance, universal hyperbolicity and simultaneous overlap; read argument, not independently reconstructing all singular diagram surgeries.
Proposition 3.1, Lemmas 3.2 and 4.1–4.4: graph choices, finite cycle direct sum, primal/dual code bounds, exact relations and Haar marginals.

Equations (17)–(36), Lemmas 5.2–5.4, Propositions 5.5 and 6.1: faithful regular representations, global deficit via disjoint exterior charges, gap and functional calculus, trace and assembly obstruction.

dependencies.role: Localized assembly trace image ΛG, applied to 1⊗x; no surjectivity hypothesis.
